fields.name: clip
fields.tooltip: The soundtrack. Authored as a seamless loop: the source loops it and every play may start anywhere in it.

fields.name: volume
fields.tooltip: Source volume at full level. The player's MUSIC slider (the mixer's MusicVolume) sits on top of this and is never touched by the system.

fields.name: randomStart
fields.tooltip: Start every play (scene start, every RETRY) at a random point in the loop instead of its first beat. Off on the Store's asset: the shop always opens on the track's first beat.

fields.name: fadeInSeconds
fields.tooltip: Seconds the music takes to rise from silence when a play starts. Real time — unaffected by the loop slow-mo or a pause.

fields.name: fadeOutSeconds
fields.tooltip: Seconds the music takes to fall to silence when the run is LOST (caught, timed out, destroyed). A WIN fades over the glitch ramp + hold on GameSettings instead, so it lands silent as the Mission Complete panel opens. The main menu never fades its loop itself — the loading curtain's duck takes it out.
